Lodging and camping

Basin Lodge has 24 rooms and six cabins on the water. Cedar Flats has 80 campsites back in the trees. Summer weekends sell out by March, so book early or come midweek.

  • Lodge room

    from $189/night

    Includes breakfast and an hour of canoe rental. Half the rooms face the lake, so ask for one of those.

  • Lakeside cabin

    from $240/night

    Sleeps four. Wood stove, kitchenette, and about twenty steps to the dock.

  • Cedar Flats campsite

    $28/night

    Fire ring, picnic table, bear locker, and a water tap every few sites. Quiet hours are 10 pm to 6 am.

  • Backcountry permit

    $12 per group

    Required for overnight trips above Halloran Meadows. Pick it up in person at the ranger station.

Echo Basin National Park Echo Basin National Park is managed by the Echo Basin Park Authority.
